messages.title: Bronco Prime Barrel: 45 → 25 Ducats
messages.body:
DE will reduce its Ducat value on 15 October 2026 at 15:00 UTC (11 a.m. ET).
If you want Ducats, exchange spare barrels at a Relay Ducat kiosk before then for 20 extra Ducats each. Opening relics alone doesn't lock in the value.
Keep copies you need for crafting and compare the Platinum price before exchanging.
